parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified CF-Chef architecture: TPS2121 power mux arbitration, AP63203WU buck regulation, ESP32-C3 SPI thermocouple channels, TPS1H200 high-side heater switch, USB-C/barrel inputs, two fan tach inputs, and WS2812B status LED. The large reference-designator and test-point name differences are functional renumbering rather than evidence of a behavior-changing anomaly.
